name: io.pinbridge/pinbridge
description: Publish and schedule Pinterest pins from any MCP client. Token refresh and retries handled.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. OAuth-capable clients (such as Claude) connect via the server's built-in OAuth flow with no header. Otherwise, pass a PinBridge API key as 'Bearer pb_<64 hex characters>' — create one in the dashboard at https://www.pinbridge.io (the free Playground plan works).
